passage: Many trees in cold climates drop all of their leaves each year. Why do some trees lose their leaves in ______ Scientists point to the need to save water during winter, when the ground is frozen.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: "Why do some trees lose their leaves in autumn" is a direct question.
A direct question ends with a question mark.
A period, comma or semicolon would not mark it as a question.
key: Direct questions end with a question mark, even in the middle of a passage.
